name: @erp/desktop
description: 777 ERP — offline-first manufacturing ERP desktop application
author: T&T Traders

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{ recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && node ./scripts/build-renderer.mjs && node ./scripts/write-build-info.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build && node ./scripts/write-build-info.mjs --strict && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && node ./scripts/write-build-info.mjs --strict && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.yml
